decontamination_notes: Real bug fix from pydantic/pydantic PR #13667 (issue #13660), merged 2026-08-16, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. Discriminated-union tag inference only accepted Literal schemas, so a member annotating its tag field as bare None failed model build with PydanticUserError while the equivalent Literal[None] worked. The fix (multi_file) widens tag handling in pydantic/_internal/_discriminated_union.py to accept none schemas as tags, adjusts pydantic/json_schema.py so the OpenAPI discriminator mapping emits the 'null' key, and loosens the (runtime-inert) TypedDict hints in the in-tree pydantic-core/python/pydantic_core/core_schema.py. Monorepo sliced at the PR base commit (c04e4168) to pydantic/ + pyproject.toml + LICENSE plus the in-tree pydantic-core/python sources for realistic navigation — the hyphenated pydantic-core dir is not importable, so `import pydantic_core` always resolves to the compiled wheel baked into the per-task image vulcanbench/sandbox:pydantic-13667 (sandbox/Dockerfile.pydantic-13667: base + pydantic-core==2.48.0, the exact version this base commit pins, + typing-extensions/annotated-types/typing-inspection; pydantic itself overlaid via PYTHONPATH=.). Coverage: 3 fail_to_pass tests with models built inside each test (so the base-time build error fails each individually), verified failing at base and passing after the gold patch — None-tagged member builds and validates, literal member still routes, and the JSON-schema 'null' mapping; 5 pass_to_pass guards pin literal unions routing/rejecting, their JSON schema mapping, plain model validation, and the Literal[None] spelling that already worked at base. Assertions check types, routing and schema mapping via public APIs, never message text.
